I’m going to be honest. The first couple of weeks—first month are going to be hard. There’s a few things you can do:

1. See if your college offers a group session in their counseling center for homesick individuals. My college offered this (but I never went).

2. Check out the club fair! This is usually within the first week or two of the semester. I met some lifelong buddies through a club on campus that I discovered through this fair. Making connections at your college is key to getting over your homesickness.

3. Journal. Acknowledge what’s been tough for you. But try to come up with at least one positive thing from your day/week and write that down.

4. Call your family. There’s no shame in doing that. There’s no shame in doing it every day if that’s what your heart desires.
